gameplay_and_controls.details: HUD displays assist notifications when team members knock down wounded enemies
Extended target marking; double tap to pin enemy locations
Independent toggles for parachuting and driving
Combined drag and tap sprinting input methods

optimizations_and_fixes: Guild leaders/elders can set minimum Clash Squad rank for applicants
Radio command users blink on minimap
Auto-receive Gloo Walls in Training Grounds Combat Zone
Universal Fragments display optimized in level-up menu
Hardcore mode supported in custom rooms
Improved outside play zone graphics display for better visibility
Location names displayed on ground during parachuting (BR)
Kill streak notification volume slider added in settings
Player alias feature added for friend list
Weapon/skin special effects disabled while in active combat
